title: Unwrap bound callback hooks before caching signatures to prevent memory leaks
answers: Why are callback objects or listeners not garbage collected after fit?
How should callback hook signatures be cached in sklearn.callback?
How to prevent signature caching from keeping callback instances alive?
body:
Symptom: Callback instances and background resources (e.g., listeners or threads) are not garbage-collected after fitting an estimator.
Root cause: sklearn/callback/_callback_context.py:CallbackContext caches signatures on bound hook methods, holding strong references to callback instances.
Fix pattern: Unwrap bound methods via getattr(hook, "__func__", hook) to cache signatures by function rather than bound instance method.
Constraints: Applies when caching signatures or inspect metadata on instance hooks; not applicable when hooks are already standalone functions.
applies: Signature caching and lifecycle management of callback hooks in sklearn.callback.
